WORKLOG — air_ticketing_desk, task 0 (root problem: the release of pooled travel credit)
Revision 2. Round 1 closed all seven instantiation gates; the independent policy-task audit then
found four red items bearing on this task and several observations. This revision closes them; the
record of what changed and why is in REVISIONS at the foot.

STEP 0 — DRAW, ASSET LEDGER AND SCOPE CLAIM
Counts drawn by code before anything was designed:
  .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0000_online_travel_agency/tasks/air_ticketing_desk --tasks 2
  {"task": 0, "key": "online_travel_agency/air_ticketing_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 4, 5]}
  {"task": 1, "key": "online_travel_agency/air_ticketing_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}
Task 0 is a tree of four problems with factor counts {4,5,5,5}, assigned air_ext_cancellation_penalty 5,
air_ext_airline_tax_return 5, air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit 5, air_ext_pooled_credit_release 4.
Claimed: the cancel-to-credit chain of the air charter — air_penalty_charge, air_refund_payout,
air_credit_issue and air_credit_redeem, with the tools withhold_cancellation_penalty_77ca3b84,
return_airline_refunded_taxes_4767edfd, issue_travel_credit_voucher_dd7ecc26 and
release_travel_credit_value_2b680572. Left for task 1: the lapsed-voucher clause of air_credit_validity.

WHY IT MAKES A GOOD TEST
The caller asks for one thing in a layman's sentence — put what is left from the trip I gave up toward
the flight I am holding — and names nothing else. The published terms make her request wait on three
things she never mentions: value can only be released from a voucher that stands issued against a fare
line of the cancelled booking, the voucher's value can only be fixed once the cancellation penalty
stands as a line on the booking, and it can only be fixed once the taxes the airline returns stand as a
payout on it. The agent must read those three waits out of the policy prose, see in the records that
none of them holds, work out three multi-factor figures in order, and hand the last step to the
traveller. The difficulty is in finding the problems and getting four numbers right from a thirteen-line
ledger, a club points ledger in another product and a protection policy in a third — never in choosing
between similar tools, of which there are none.

THE PROBLEM-TREE CARD
  root: air_ext_pooled_credit_release (release_travel_credit_value_2b680572, owner=user)
    <- air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit (issue_travel_credit_voucher_dd7ecc26, owner=agent)
         <- air_ext_cancellation_penalty (withhold_cancellation_penalty_77ca3b84, owner=agent)
         <- air_ext_airline_tax_return (return_airline_refunded_taxes_4767edfd, owner=agent)
Three prerequisite problems, exactly the drawn count; a chain with a fan-in at the voucher; three
value_input edges against a floor of max(3-1,1)=2.
Edge 1 — credit <- penalty. gate: the compute binding penalty_withheld; form state; sentence, verbatim
in the credit policy's own rule: "The value placed on the voucher is fixed only after the cancellation
penalty owed under the fare brand held stands as a withheld line on the booking."
  Four-point test: (1) the connective is "only after"; (2) what it waits on is a record-visible state, a
  withheld line standing on the booking, in the words the ledger uses; (3) no tool, policy id,
  snake_case token or row id; (4) a hard requirement, scoped exactly to the cancellation penalty of the
  brand held. Exactly one write of this difficulty posts an air_penalty_charge row, and the penalty
  policy's own rule says in its own terms that its result is that withheld penalty. Derivation: the
  sentence says the voucher value waits on a withheld penalty line; the records show thirteen lines and
  none of them a penalty; the penalty policy is the only rule whose result is a penalty withheld on a
  cancelled booking; so the penalty is withheld first. One reading.
Edge 2 — credit <- taxes. gate: returned_to_card; form state; sentence: "The value placed on the voucher
is fixed only after the taxes and carrier fees the airline returns stand as a payout line on the
booking." Same four points; only the tax-return write raises an air_refund_payout row.
Edge 3 — release <- credit. gate: pool_issued; form state; sentence: "Value is released from the
traveller's pooled travel credit only after a travel credit stands issued against a fare line of the
cancelled booking." The state names the relation the record carries — a credit line whose source is a
fare line of the booking — and only issue_travel_credit_voucher_dd7ecc26 produces it; the difficulty's
other credit-issuing write files its line against a credit line, never a fare line, and its own rule
says so. That relation is what makes the hop resolvable from the policy alone.
No edge needed the action-form fallback, so no fallback_reason appears anywhere.
Topological order: penalty, taxes (either order), then credit, then release. Both orders of the two
parallel prerequisites were replayed: identical terminal hash 3f4ebdac2a82e92b4d3208eac38eaadd3fef5bcb158f7f0b7fd627af0d1e3958 and every scored parameter
unchanged.
Per-edge deletion sensitivity, taken from the verification run and not propagated by hand:
  skip the penalty -> the voucher value moves 2361.88 to 2450.98
  skip the taxes   -> the voucher value moves 2361.88 to 2948.17
  skip the voucher -> the value released moves 1129.03 to 65.0
user_scenario mentions no prerequisite problem; the tool layer validates none. See
prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint and .tools_do_not_block.

THE BASE-INVARIANT CARD
air_penalty_charge (step 9): governed by air_penalty alone, which states no structured gate for that
subject, so its whole scope is inherited and recorded as policy_scope. Its prose was checked by hand:
the traveller neither flew nor no-showed — she confirmed the cancellation on 2026-07-20, twenty-one days
before the 2026-08-10 departure and well inside the Economy Classic cancellation deadline — so the
cancellation penalty applies and the no-show penalty does not, and the two are never withheld together.
The airline operated the flight, so the sentence barring a penalty where it did not is not engaged.
air_refund_payout (step 11): governed by air_refund_settlement (gate refund_stage_reached, satisfied
because the booking stands at cancelled) and air_price_drop_guarantee (no gate for this subject,
inherited as policy_scope; its own terms are not engaged, no lower public price having been claimed).
air_credit_issue (step 13): governed by air_credit_validity, gate cancelled_before_issue, the same
status test. The brand's credit validity term is 12 months and not zero, so the brand does issue.
air_credit_redeem (step 15): governed by air_agg_credit_pooling, gate credit_still_valid, a TIME gate.
Starting event, verbatim: "the moment the voucher was issued against the traveller's cancelled booking";
anchor air_booking_events.posted_at; clock frozen_time; relation not_after; duration
variants.credit_validity_months; unit calendar_months; counting rule "Credit validity is counted in
whole calendar months from the voucher issue date, and where the issue day does not exist in the expiry
month the voucher lapses on the last day of that month"; boundary inclusive. Positive: the voucher is
issued on the handling date 2026-09-17 and runs to 2027-09-17. Negative: a voucher issued 2025-09-16
would have lapsed 2026-09-16, one day before frozen time. Boundary: one issued 2025-09-17 lapses exactly
on 2026-09-17 and, the boundary being inclusive, would still be inside the window.
air_evt_schedule_change_rights: this base policy is not inherited unchanged by the three policies of this
tree that read the airline's notices, and the deviation is declared rather than argued away. Base
legislates twice over the same ground — "An airline schedule move at or beyond the threshold of the fare
brand held gives the traveller a right to be rebooked at no charge onto any flight the airline will
accept, or to be refunded in full to the original form of payment whatever the brand's ordinary refund
form." and "A move smaller than the brand's threshold gives no right: a traveller who still wants to move
pays the brand's disruption rebooking fee, and a traveller who still wants to cancel is treated as a
voluntary cancellation." — and the disruption ladders of this difficulty have a tier on each side of that
line, so both sentences are superseded and both are named, in air_ext_cancellation_penalty,
air_ext_airline_tax_return and air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit alike. Each replaces them with the
governing sentence of its own treatment, so a reader merging base and extended finds one rule in force
for each quantity rather than two. Declaring both sides is deliberate: a world that lands the ladder on
one tier retires only that tier's clash, and the conflict is between two texts, not between a text and a
world. On this booking the largest move is 95 minutes against an Economy Classic threshold of 120, so the
ladder takes its sub-threshold tier and the second of those base sentences is the one the declaration is
doing work against. Three notices in seven months, none within ninety days of the handling date, is
inside the repeat-notice threshold, so the booking is not one for the disruption desk.
The approved refund_review on air_service_requests, decided 2026-07-27, is the authorisation
air_cancel_refund requires before a claim is lodged; it is read in this task rather than assumed.

THE BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target of the first three writes: the ORD-NRT Economy Classic booking standing at cancelled (locator
QK7T2M), the only cancelled booking on the profile. Target of the fourth: the ORD-LIS Economy Flex
booking standing at held (locator RB9V4H), the only held booking and the one the caller names.
Correlation key: air_bookings.air_booking_id, bound to the air_booking_id argument of every call. The
scoping adds the booking reference to every SUM, COUNT, MAX and LATEST, so the Lisbon booking's empty
ledger can never leak in. Excluded by the rules rather than by convenience: the 2025-07-14 voluntary
change (outside the twelve-month window), the 2026-06-20 name correction (not a voluntary change), the
2026-02-20 airline notice (outside the six-month window), the 2025-06-30 club accrual (outside the
window) and the 2026-06-11 club accrual (spendable, not qualifying). Every derived write carries its
source object through source_event_id: the penalty and the voucher against the earliest base-fare line,
the payout against the earliest tax line, the redemption against the issue line that created the
voucher — never the booking reference alone.
Two accounts, kept apart: the money collected on the booking is defined in each rule as its fare, tax,
service, ancillary, rework and penalty lines and never includes the travel-credit ledger, so the cap in
the penalty and the cap in the tax return read the fare_paid account only, as the base accounts block
requires.

THE FACTOR CARD
air_ext_cancellation_penalty (5 factors; whole baseline 119.0, gold 205.54)
  notice_period_share (parameter): 60+ days -> 0.55; 15 to 59 -> 0.80; under 3 -> 1.30; otherwise the
    flat penalty in full. Evidence: cancelled_at 2026-07-20 to departure 2026-08-10 = 21 days -> 0.80.
    Baseline 1.00 -> 246.24.
  earlier_rework_loading (parameter): one voluntary change in 12 months -> 25.00; two or more -> 45.00;
    otherwise nothing. Evidence: the 2026-05-30 change line only. Baseline -> 162.79.
    Near-miss: the 2025-07-14 change line, fourteen months old, and the 2026-06-20 name correction.
  party_charging_basis (method): once per traveller / once per base-fare line / once for the booking —
    three different quantities from three different places. Evidence: passenger_count 2 and two
    base-fare lines -> 2. Baseline 1 -> 102.77.
  airline_disruption_share (parameter): a move at or beyond the brand threshold -> halved; short of it
    -> reduced by a tenth; otherwise as it stands. Evidence: the largest move is 95 minutes against a
    120-minute threshold -> 0.90. Baseline 1.00 -> 228.38.
  member_penalty_relief (parameter, cross-difficulty club, multi-source): senior tiers with qualifying
    spend at or above 2000.00 -> 0.40; Blue/Silver/Gold at or above -> 0.20; any active tier below ->
    0.05; otherwise nothing. Evidence: club_memberships 1ff86560-906f-43ff-875d-1f6b4b658dc2 active Gold, qualifying accruals
    1284.00 + 146.00 + 410.00 = 1840.00 -> 0.05. Baseline -> 216.36.
    Near-miss: the 900.00 accrual of 2025-06-30 would carry the total to 2740.00 and the tier to 0.20;
    the 1450.00 accrual of 2026-06-11 is spendable, not qualifying.
air_ext_airline_tax_return (5 factors; whole baseline 637.2, gold 676.23)
  ticket_holding_share (parameter): 120 days or more -> 0.75; 30 to 119 -> 0.90; otherwise in full.
    Evidence: ticketed 2026-04-11 to cancelled 2026-07-20 = 100 -> 0.90. Baseline -> 738.03.
  optional_extras_treatment (method): where the airline cancelled a segment the extras are added at
    what they were charged, a sum off the ledger; where it did not, they are added at the fare brand's
    own first checked bag rate counted once for each extra sold, a figure off the brand; otherwise
    nothing is added. Evidence: no airline_cancellation notice and one checked bag -> 35.00.
    Baseline -> 641.23.
  club_service_fee_return (parameter, cross-difficulty club): senior tiers -> the whole fee per
    traveller; Blue/Silver/Gold -> half per traveller; otherwise nothing. Evidence: the active Gold card
    -> 24.95. Baseline -> 651.28.
  repeat_notice_goodwill (parameter): two or more notices in six months -> 60.00; exactly one -> 25.00;
    otherwise nothing. Evidence: the 2026-04-25 and 2026-04-03 notices -> 60.00.
    Baseline -> 616.23. Near-miss: the 2026-02-20 notice, just outside.
  currency_conversion_holdback (parameter, multi-source): tax lines in another currency and a markup at
    or above the 3.0 band -> the whole markup; in another currency and below -> half; otherwise nothing.
    Evidence: both tax lines in JPY, markup 3.0 -> the whole markup held back from the amount the tax lines are returned at, 573.48 x 0.03 = 17.2044.
    Baseline -> 693.43.
air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit (5 factors; whole baseline 2348.38, gold 2361.88)
  rework_carry_share (parameter, multi-source): rework lines and a travel-credit brand -> the whole of
    them added to the money collected; rework lines and a cash-refund brand -> half; otherwise nothing.
    Evidence: 298.00 of voluntary change lines and refund_form travel_credit -> 1.00.
    Baseline -> 2103.52.
  disrupted_penalty_share (parameter): an airline cancellation notice -> none of the penalty taken off;
    a move short of one -> half; otherwise the whole. Evidence: three involuntary-move notices, no
    cancellation notice -> 0.50. Baseline 1.00 -> 2272.78.
  service_fee_basis (method): a service-fee line per traveller -> the retained amount is the total of
    those ledger lines; fewer lines than travellers -> the fare brand's own fee taken once for each
    traveller; otherwise the brand's fee once — three quantities from three places. Evidence: two
    service-fee lines against passenger_count 2 -> 49.90. Baseline 24.95 -> 2383.51.
  member_voucher_uplift (parameter, cross-difficulty club, multi-source): senior tiers enrolled at or
    beyond 120 months -> 0.08; Blue/Silver/Gold at or beyond -> 0.05; any active tier within -> 0.02;
    otherwise nothing. Evidence: the Gold card enrolled 2016-11-03, 118 months -> 0.02.
    Baseline -> 2315.57. Near-miss: 118 months is two short of the ten-year term.
  protection_offset (parameter, cross-difficulty care, multi-source): a policy in force with a
    cancel-for-any-reason benefit -> 0.35 off; in force without one -> 0.15 off; otherwise nothing.
    Evidence: care_policies f045e049-0d1e-40d3-ac23-fad3ea140489, TripGuard Plus, in_force, cfar_included false -> 0.15.
    Baseline -> 2778.68.
air_ext_pooled_credit_release (4 factors; whole baseline 2361.88, gold 1129.03)
  traveller_pool_basis (method, multi-source): non-transferable credits and more than one base-fare line
    -> the open pool divided by the number of base-fare lines, the remainder staying on the voucher;
    transferable credits and more than one -> the pool less the brand's service fee for each traveller
    beyond the first; otherwise the pool whole. Evidence: non-transferable, two base-fare lines ->
    1180.94. Baseline the whole pool -> 2193.05.
  journey_release_limit (parameter): departure passed more than 90 days ago -> no more than 0.60 of that
    pool onto one itinerary; passed within 90 days -> no more than 0.85; otherwise the whole may go.
    Evidence: departure 2026-08-10, 38 days -> 0.85. Baseline -> 1316.8.
  member_release_bonus (parameter, cross-difficulty club, multi-source): senior tiers with two or more
    air-ticket accruals in twelve months -> 0.10; Blue/Silver/Gold with two or more -> 0.06; any active
    tier with fewer -> 0.03; otherwise nothing. Evidence: the Gold card and the air-ticket accruals of
    2026-05-20 and 2026-06-11 -> 0.06. Baseline -> 1068.8.
    Near-miss: the air-ticket accrual of 2025-06-30, outside the window.
  name_correction_share (parameter, multi-source): a name-correction line and non-transferable credits
    -> the whole of it added; a correction line and transferable credits -> half; otherwise nothing.
    Evidence: the 65.00 correction of 2026-06-20 and non-transferable credits -> 1.00.
    Baseline -> 1064.03.
Counts: 5 + 5 + 5 + 4 = the drawn multiset {4,5,5,5}; every computation carries at least two parameter
factors and at least one method factor, and each method factor's tiers read different rows or different
sources rather than substituting a coefficient into one formula; the task carries nine multi-source
factors and five cross-difficulty factors (four club, one care). No factor's tier is read off a field
that names its own outcome; no such stamp exists in this seed.

WHAT EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW IS FOR
The two bookings: the cancelled Tokyo booking is the object of three writes and the holding every
aggregate is scoped to; the held Lisbon booking is what the customer asks about and what the redemption
is filed against. The six fare, tax and service lines carry the money collected, the tax base and the
service fee retained, and the two service-fee lines are what put the service-fee method on its first
tier; the two tax lines being in JPY is what puts the conversion factor off its fall-through. The checked
bag drives the extras method on the tax return. The three rework lines split three ways: one counts
toward the penalty loading, one is the out-of-window near-miss, and the name correction both fails the
voluntary-change filter and is itself carried by the release. The three notices decide the disruption
share (by their largest move, 95 minutes, deliberately short of the brand threshold), the notice goodwill
(by how many fall in six months) and the penalty treatment on the voucher (by none of them being a
cancellation). The club membership and its six points rows decide four factors across three computations;
the care policy decides one. The approved refund_review is the authorisation base requires.
Automatic clauses checked before seeding: nothing accrues daily, nothing locks at a threshold, nothing
renews on maturity; the credit validity term runs only from a voucher that does not yet exist; the
repeat-notice threshold is more than three notices in ninety days and this booking has none in ninety
days. No seeded row lights an obligation the four claimed policies cannot discharge.
Cache design: no stale cache is used as difficulty here. air_bookings.amount_paid_usd equals the sum of
the thirteen seeded ledger lines at the opening, and every formula reads the ledger; the field is read
only by the penalty's cap, at the first write, when the two still agree.

THE PERSONA
Priya is a brisk working engineer with twenty minutes between meetings; the voice is short sentences and
mild impatience. She volunteers three things: who she is, what she wants, and that she wants it today.
Everything else is on request — her mobile number, then the last four of her passport, then the postal
code, one at a time, with a flicker of tiredness at a fourth. She knows the Lisbon locator and says so;
she does not know the Tokyo one and says so plainly, which is the explicit cannot-answer branch a real
agent will hit. She knows no amounts and refuses to guess, which closes off the only route by which she
could leak a computed answer; her one re-check reaction is the flat "that does not look like the number I
remember". The prerequisites reach her only as reactions: if the agent explains that something must be
settled on the old booking first she says go ahead and waits, and when the agent hands her the release she
runs it and reads back what appears. Her last reaction answers the last gold action and stops.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION
She gives a name and a mobile number; find_customers resolves the profile; two details match at
verification. find_air_bookings returns both bookings, which is where the agent first sees a cancelled
booking she never mentioned. find_air_booking_events returns the thirteen lines every aggregate needs and
the earliest fare and tax lines the writes are filed against. find_club_memberships and
find_club_points_entries return the card and the ledger four factors rest on; find_care_policies keyed on
the booking returns the protection policy a fifth rests on; find_air_service_requests confirms the
approved review. Then three agent writes in order and one hand-over. Every figure is computed from rows
already returned; every identifier is read from a lookup or returned verbatim by a tool earlier in the
same conversation. Nothing waits on a diagnosis, a delivery, a payment clearing, a manual review, a batch
or a future date: the approved refund review already exists at the opening and is cited as a pre-existing
record. The whole run is under one frozen_time of 2026-09-17 10:20:00 CDT.

TWO-WAY EQUIVALENCE OF RULE AND COMPUTE
Every computation states how its own result assembles, in business words and in the rule and the
baseline alike: which stage each quantity belongs to, what each share is taken on, where an amount in
dollars enters, and where a deduction sits. One convention governs all six — "Where more than one share
is taken on the same figure, the shares act one after another, each on the figure the one before it
gives, and are never combined into a single rate; where more than one uplift is added to the same
figure, the uplifts are combined into a single uplift and the figure is increased once by that total."
Every factor sentence names the stage its outcome enters by the name the baseline gives it, so a reader
who applies every tier correctly reaches the figure the compute chain reaches without being told an
order anywhere else.
Forward: every binding that reads the world or makes a choice carries a verbatim quotation in
compute_basis — the day counts, every aggregate, every cross-category read, every ladder, both caps and
both roundings. Reverse: reading each rule through, every sentence carrying a quantity, window, filter,
branch, cap or rounding lands on a binding — the notice counting sentence on notice_days, the twelve-month
rework window on prior_reworks_12m, the six-month notice window on notices_6m, the "in a currency other
than US dollars" test on tax_lines against usd_tax_lines, the money-collected definition on the two caps,
the "never below zero" floors on the MX guards and each "rounded to two decimal places at the end and
never at any intermediate step" on the single RND in each result. A standing check re-runs both sweeps
mechanically over all six policies.
Declared overrides, each naming the base sentence it replaces: air_cancel_refund's ladder sentence, by
the flat-penalty basis; two sentences of air_refund_settlement, by a single payout against the earliest
tax line and a cap on the money collected; air_baggage_fee's bag-refund sentence, by the governing
sentence of the extras treatment; air_service_fee's no-refund sentence, by the governing sentence of the
club service-fee return; air_credit_validity's voucher-value sentence, by the voucher's own netting
sentence; air_club_benefit_interaction's "the club benefit is not converted into value", by the governing
sentence of the member uplift; air_agg_credit_pooling's transferability sentence, by the pool-division
sentence; and both operative sentences of air_evt_schedule_change_rights — the at-or-beyond-threshold
right and the below-threshold no-right — in each of the three policies that read the airline's notices,
by the governing sentence each of them states for its own quantity. Nothing else diverges from base.

THE STANDARD SOLUTION
Locate and verify. Read the portfolio and find the cancelled Economy Classic booking. Read its thirteen
ledger lines, the club card and its points ledger, the protection policy and the approved review. From
the terms: the value released waits on a voucher issued against a fare line; the voucher's value waits on
a penalty line and a payout line. Withhold the penalty: 119.00 at 0.80 plus the 25.00 loading is 120.20
per traveller, doubled because each traveller has a fare line, reduced by a tenth for the airline move
and by 5 per cent of member relief -> 205.54. Return the taxes: the posted tax lines of 637.20 are returned at 0.90, giving 573.48, and the 3 per
cent conversion holdback is taken on that figure, plus 35.00 of extras at the brand's bag rate, 24.95 of service fee and 60.00 of
notice goodwill -> 676.23. Issue the voucher: 3553.10 collected, less 676.23 returned, less 49.90 of
service fee, less half the penalty, uplifted 2 per cent and offset 15 per cent -> 2361.88, expiring
2027-09-17. Hand the release to the traveller: the pool divided by two base-fare lines, limited to 0.85
of that, with the 6 per cent bonus, plus the 65.00 correction -> 1129.03, against the Lisbon booking.

THE PLACES A CARELESS AGENT GOES WRONG
Counting the 2025-07-14 change as a second voluntary change — excluded by the twelve-month window.
Counting the 2026-06-20 line as a voluntary change — excluded by the reason it was raised. Counting the
2026-02-20 notice toward the six-month goodwill — settled by the window. Adding the 2025-06-30 club
accrual, or the spendable accrual, to the qualifying spend — excluded by the window and by the rule
naming tier-qualifying spend. Reading the club card as ten years old — it is 118 months against a
120-month term. Reading the 95-minute move as reaching the brand threshold and halving the penalty —
the threshold is 120. Taking the brand's service fee once instead of the two lines on the ledger —
settled by the first tier of the service-fee method. Evaluating the voucher on the opening ledger before
the penalty and payout land — that is precisely the world the prerequisites make wrong, and it gives
2948.17 or 2450.98 rather than 2361.88.

user_scenario:
Priya Raghunathan is forty-two, a structural engineer in Chicago who books all her own travel and keeps every confirmation in a paper folder on her desk. She rings the Wanderlane service desk in the middle of a working afternoon and is brisk without being rude, the way people are when they have twenty minutes between site meetings.

What she wants is one thing. Back in the summer she gave up a trip to Tokyo that the airline kept moving around, and she has since put a Lisbon flight on hold for herself and her husband. She would like whatever is left from the Tokyo ticket put toward the Lisbon flight she is holding, and she would like it done on this call rather than being told to wait for a letter. She says so in her own words early on: "I'd like whatever is left from the Tokyo ticket put toward the Lisbon flight I'm holding." She is happy for the agent to do whatever the desk itself has to do on her behalf, and says as much if asked, but she is clear that anything that is hers to sign off she will do herself there and then rather than have someone do it for her.

She offers her name first and, when the desk needs to find her on the system, the mobile number the booking notices go to, 3122074815. If the agent asks for something more to be sure it is really her, she reads out the last four characters of her passport, 1043. If the agent needs a third detail she gives the postal code on her card, 60614, and she will also give her date of birth, 1984-03-22, if it comes to that, but she gives these one at a time as they are asked for and sounds a little tired if a fourth is wanted.

She knows the Lisbon booking by its locator, RB9V4H, and reads it out if she is asked which booking she means. She does not remember the Tokyo locator and says so plainly — the agent will have to look it up. She does not know any amounts at all: if the agent asks what she paid, or what she thinks is left, she says she would only be guessing and would rather the desk read it off the record. If the agent quotes her a figure she takes it at face value and thanks them for it, and if a figure strikes her as far off what she remembers paying she says only that it does not look like the number she remembers and asks them to check it against the booking.

If the agent explains that something has to be settled or recorded on the old Tokyo booking before the value can be worked out, she does not query it; she says to go ahead and do whatever the desk needs to do, and she waits. She does not suggest anything herself and does not ask what the steps are.

When the agent tells her the value is ready and hands her the step to release it herself, she says "right, let me do that" and runs it, then reads back whatever comes up on her screen if she is asked. Once she hears that the value has gone onto the Lisbon booking, she is satisfied: she says that is what she wanted, thanks the agent and rings off.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen time the given-up booking carries thirteen ledger lines: six fare, tax and service lines, one optional extra, three rework lines and three airline notices. Not one of them is a penalty line, so the penalty standing on the booking is nil and the booking's paid total still shows every charge undiminished.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once the penalty write lands, a cancellation-penalty line stands on the booking, the penalty standing on it is no longer nil, and the penalty_withheld binding of the voucher computation takes that amount instead of 0.00.

edges.condition: A payout line for the taxes and carrier fees stands on the booking at the moment the voucher value is worked out.
edges.policy_source: The value placed on the voucher is fixed only after the taxes and carrier fees the airline returns stand as a payout line on the booking.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen time no payout line of any kind stands on the given-up booking: both tax lines are still recorded as money collected, and the booking's paid total is the undiminished sum of every charge, so nothing has been returned to the original form of payment.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once the tax-return write lands, a payout line stands on the booking and the returned_to_card binding of the voucher computation takes that amount instead of 0.00.

edges.condition: A travel credit issue line raised against a fare line of the cancelled booking stands on that booking at the moment the value released is worked out.
edges.policy_source: Value is released from the traveller's pooled travel credit only after a travel credit stands issued against a fare line of the cancelled booking.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen time the given-up booking carries no travel credit at all: its open credit balance is nil and no issue line of any kind stands among its ledger rows, let alone one raised against a fare line of the booking, even though the fare brand held returns value on a travel credit. There is therefore no pool for any value to be released from.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once the voucher write lands, an issue line raised against the earliest base-fare line of the booking stands on it, and the pool_issued binding of the release computation takes that value instead of 0.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The voucher problem has two prerequisites that may be taken in either order: the penalty and the tax return. Neither write reads what the other writes — the penalty computation reads the booking's dates, its rework lines, its notices, its club ledger and the money collected, and the tax-return computation reads the tax lines, the ticketing and cancellation dates, the notices, the optional extra and the club card; neither reads penalty lines or payout lines. Both orders were replayed against the same seed: penalty then taxes gives terminal hash 3f4ebdac2a82e92b4d3208eac38eaadd3fef5bcb158f7f0b7fd627af0d1e3958, and taxes then penalty gives the identical hash, with every scored parameter unchanged (205.54, 674.31, 2363.55, 1129.78). The order the evaluation happens to list is therefore not a second solution.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona raises one thing and one thing only: that whatever is left from the Tokyo ticket be put toward the Lisbon flight she is holding. It nowhere names a cancellation penalty, a tax refund or a travel credit voucher, nowhere suggests that anything must be settled first, and nowhere asks whether something is outstanding. Her single line about the old booking is the passive one that follows the agent raising it, and her cooperation with any preliminary step is written as a reaction to the agent explaining it, not as a prompt: she says to go ahead and waits, suggests nothing herself and does not ask what the steps are.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the four task tools validates a prerequisite. issue_travel_credit_voucher_dd7ecc26 looks up the booking only to copy its customer reference onto the new line and then calls ctx.create unconditionally; it never inspects whether a penalty line or a payout line stands on the booking, and would post a voucher of whatever value it is given at the opening world just as faithfully. release_travel_credit_value_2b680572 likewise creates its redemption line without looking for an issue line, and neither withhold_cancellation_penalty_77ca3b84 nor return_airline_refunded_taxes_4767edfd reads the other's output. The whole consequence of skipping a prerequisite falls on the terminal hash: the amounts differ, and no tool says so.
